violations.text: The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was lacking paper towels. Paper towels were provided during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/27/2026

The walk-in cooler was observed held at an ambient temperature of 45 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Per PIC, staff had loaded food from unit for delivery to off-site locations that establishment services and had left the door open during the process. During the time of inspection, the walk-in cooler door was observed ajar due to faulty automatic door closing mechanism. Walk-in cooler was observed to recover to an ambient temperature of 40 degrees Fahrenheit during the time of inspection. Food items within the unit were evaluated and moved to the walk-in freezer to rapidly cool before returning to unit for cold holding. Food items above safe temperature range were voluntarily disposed of during the time of inspection. Per PIC, refrigeration service is enroute to evaluate the unit for proper functionality. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/27/2026

Working containers (spray bottles) used for storing chemicals taken from bulk supplies were not marked with the common name of the chemical. Spray bottles were labeled during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/27/2026

Cooked lobster meat was observed thawed in the walk-in cooler with intact reduced oxygen packaging (ROP). Seafood items packaged within ROP packaging shall be completely removed from its original packaging prior to thawing to allow the reintroduction of oxygen into the food item. Food items were observed held at 44 degrees Fahrenheit and voluntarily disposed of during the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/27/2026

The walk-in cooler door and automatic door closing mechanism was observed unable to remain closed and was not in good repair. Per PIC, refrigeration services is enroute with part to repair self-closing mechanism. New Violation. Correct By: 08/03/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to prevent the accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 07/27/2026

Raw animal foods (such as shell eggs) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (such as vegetables and prepared food items) in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Shell eggs were moved to alternate location during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/29/2025

Imitation crab was observed thawing with intact reduced oxygen packaging (ROP). Seafood items packaged in ROP packaging shall be completely removed from their original packaging prior to thawing. Food items were removed from original packaging during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/29/2025

Bowls are being used as scoops in containers of various dry ingredients. Utensils used to dispense non-time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods such as sugar and flour must be stored in the food item with their handles above the top of the food within the container. Bowls were removed during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 05/29/2025

The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine and the fan guards and ceiling of the walk-in cooler have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to prevent the accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 05/29/2025
